writeup: TIC 405392578 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 5.1626 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing the star to dim by 3.39 percent, with a strong signal-to-noise ratio of 95.6. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal's reality through difference imaging, though the centroid offset of 4.2 arcsec from the target's catalog position warrants attention. No secondary eclipse was detected in the data. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a potentially novel system. The automated machine-learning screening score of 0.53 indicates moderate confidence that this is a genuine eclipsing binary rather than a false positive or instrumental artifact. All data quality checks passed without flags.
